description: This file defines a Flutter widget called LearnScreen that displays a list of lessons retrieved from a repository, and navigates to detailed lesson views when tapped.

classes.name: LearnScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that fetches and displays a list of lessons for learning.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

classes.name: _LearnScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the lesson list, loading state, and building the UI.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers loading of lessons.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches lessons from repository and updates state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree displaying either a progress indicator or a list of lessons.
